findings.text: the head gate arm's header names revision 8c3d96f4 rather than the reviewed landing head 7f33be51; the head commit is docs-only so the arm is materially at head, but the receipt is not pinned to a sha a later reader resolves.

the head gate adds one failing id, test_a_discarded_run_is_not_recreated (assert supervisor_pid, pointer pid 0); the base arm passed it, the node records no causal attribution, and the supervisor pointer lifecycle is outside this node's write scope, so it is reported not triaged.

the after arm was sampled at load 27-31 while base/before were sampled at 23-27, so part of the 2.653 s overshoot below the historical base median is confounded by host load; the SQL probe's in-transaction receipts support the mechanism independently, but the two arms are not at parity.
